{{Article header|section=Ships & Equipment|context=Ships|deck=Large Vodel Surface Recon Vehicle built for planetary Surface Mining.}}
{{SRV infobox}}

The '''Rhino''' is a large [[Surface Recon Vehicles|Surface Recon Vehicle]] manufactured by [[Vodel]] for planetary [[Surface Mining|surface mining]]. It carries up to three Commanders and combines a mineral scanner, deployable mining rigs, an onboard refinery, and 72 tonnes of cargo capacity. The vehicle deploys only from a [[Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar]] fitted to a compatible ship.<ref name="frontier-release">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/rhino-available-now-arx-early-access Rhino – Available Now Via ARX Early Access], Frontier Developments, 2 September 2026. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref><ref name="frontier-4410">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-1-0 Elite Dangerous – 4.4.1.0 Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 3 September 2026. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref>

For the complete mining workflow, see [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]].

== Handling and layout ==

The Rhino is a six-wheeled heavy SRV. Frontier describes its suspension and grip as suited to rough ground and steeper inclines while carrying mining equipment and cargo.<ref name="frontier-first-look">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/beneath-surface-your-first-look-rhino Beneath the Surface – Your First Look at the Rhino], Frontier Developments, 6 August 2026. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref><ref name="frontier-dev-log">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments, 27 August 2026. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref>

Its cockpit has three seats. The remainder of the body is used for equipment and storage, so the Rhino has no walkable interior.<ref name="frontier-first-look" />

== Built-in mining equipment ==

=== Planetary mining scanner ===

{{Main|Planetary Mineral Scanner}}

{{Context media|align=left|image=planetary_mining_deposits.png|caption=Planetary mining deposits identified by the Rhino's scanner.|
The scanner detects buried deposits inside a Planetary Mining Location and marks mineral-rich areas on the terrain and vehicle sensors.<ref name="frontier-dev-log" /> Frontier's 4.4.1.0 notes call it the '''Planetary Mining Deposit Scanner''', while the Rhino announcement and store use '''Planetary Mineral Scanner'''. Both names refer to the Rhino's built-in deposit-finding system.<ref name="frontier-4410" /><ref name="frontier-release" />
}}

The ship-mounted [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] finds Planetary Mining Locations on a body. The Rhino's scanner then finds individual deposits after the vehicle enters one of those locations.<ref name="frontier-4410" />

=== Mining Rig Deployment Module ===

The Mining Rig Deployment Module places reusable mining rigs on suitable deposits.<ref name="frontier-4410" /> Frontier's Rhino store page confirms that several rigs can operate at once.<ref name="store-standard">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/store/product/rhino-standard Rhino Standard], Elite Dangerous Gamestore, Frontier Developments. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref>

A mining rig extracts material over time. When a cycle finishes, the Rhino can recover the output and reclaim the rig for another placement. Update 4.4.1.1 raised the maximum output of a rig from 9 chunks to 12.<ref name="frontier-4411">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-1-1 Elite Dangerous – 4.4.1.1 Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 3 September 2026. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref>

Placement controls, deposit selection, rig management, and recovery belong to [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]].

=== Refinery and cargo ===

The Rhino has its own refinery for processing recovered rig output and a 72-tonne cargo hold.<ref name="frontier-4410" /><ref name="store-vehicle" /> Refined commodity cargo can be transferred to the carrier ship. Frontier's release notes also list additional Microresources as possible secondary output from surface mining.<ref name="frontier-4410" />

Frontier has not published the refinery's exact bin arrangement, partial-processing behaviour, or every full-storage edge case.

== Carrier ship and deployment ==

The Rhino cannot use the regular Planetary Vehicle Hangar or ordinary SRV cargo-hatch deployment. It requires a Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar and drops from the dedicated large-vehicle bay.<ref name="frontier-first-look" />

Frontier's live-release list supports thirteen carrier ships. Most accept hangar classes 2–6; the Keelback accepts classes 2–4. The complete compatibility table is maintained on [[Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar#Compatibility|Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar § Compatibility]].<ref name="frontier-release" />

== Crew ==

The Rhino supports one driver and two additional occupants. Frontier confirms three-Commander multi-crew capacity but has not published a complete breakdown of which mining, scanner, refinery, or cargo controls are available from each seat.<ref name="frontier-release" /><ref name="store-vehicle" />

== Availability ==

The Rhino entered Live ARX Early Access on 2 September 2026. The Standard edition costs 16,520 ARX and unlocks the Rhino in outfitting; Stellar and Galactic editions add cosmetics.<ref name="frontier-release" /><ref name="frontier-4410" /> The Standard store page states that Odyssey is required to disembark from the Rhino for on-foot activity.<ref name="store-standard" />

The accompanying Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar becomes available at most outfitting locations for compatible ships and is free with the Rhino purchase, but it is not installed automatically as part of the vehicle bundle.<ref name="store-standard" />

== Limitations ==

* The Rhino and its surface-mining activity are available only in the current Live game.
* A compatible carrier ship and Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar are required.
* The Rhino has no accessible interior.
* Planetary Mining Locations must first be revealed with a Detailed Surface Scanner; the vehicle scanner searches inside those locations.
* Deposits regenerate slowly after extraction, so one rich site is not an unlimited high-output loop.<ref name="frontier-dev-log" />
* Profit and yield depend on the selected location, commodity mix, deposit conditions, and sale market rather than the Rhino alone.
